name: HubSpot Deal to Vantagepoint Project
description:
This recipe triggers when a deal is added or updated in HubSpot, creating or updating a corresponding Vantagepoint project based on the deal name. This example syncs basic fields from HubSpot to Vantagepoint. For more complex implementations, consider including additional fields and business logic.

This Community Recipe is provided “AS-IS”. Deltek will not be liable for Account Holder’s use of it, and will not provide any indemnity, warranties, or representations for this or any Community Recipe.

block.comment: This searches for Vantagepoint projects that have the same name as the added/update Deal from HubSpot. If the project already exists in Vantagepoint we update it, otherwise we create a new Vantagepoint project

block.name: organization
block.description: Retrieve all configured organizations from Vantagepoint
block.comment: We get this list as we need the organization details for creating the project. For this example, we just use the first organization returned in the list - you may choose to have some logic to match specific HubSpot Deals to specific Vantagepoint Organizations

block.name: codetable_records
block.description: Get options configured in Project stages. list within Vantagepoint
block.comment: We get this list of Project Stages so we have something to use when creating the project in Vantagepoint. In this example, we just use the first Project Stage from the list, you may choose to implement something more nuanced based on other data properties from the HubSpot Deal (such as "Deal Closed?"

block.comment: We update the description and estimated completion date using the information passed across by HubSpot. We use some of the information retrieved as part of the Vantagepoint Project search to fill in the other required fields - this means that these fields can be edited in Vantagepoint and this recipe will honor those fields.

A Vantagepoint Project with this name already exists, so we update the project with the description and close date from the HubSpot deal. Note that we don't update the name of the Project because that is how we found the project to begin with
The Project doesn't already exist within Vantagepoint, so create a new project

code.comment: Triggers when a deal is added or updated in HubSpot. We choose some additional fields for HubSpot to include when it sends the notification, these are Name, Description, Close Date. You may choose to bring back more fields if there are additional business choices that you need to make when creating/updating the project in Vantagepoint
